description: Real bank awareness call that WARNS never to share OTP or PIN. Must not read as an OTP request.

events.text: Hello sir, this is a courtesy call from your bank to remind you never to share your OTP, PIN or card number with anyone, even bank staff.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: If anyone asks you to install any app or share a code, please disconnect and call our official number. Thank you and have a nice day.
events.speaker: caller
